name: game-generated-check
goal: New 2D and 3D projects and supported game generators pass their own normal project checks

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Full creation includes running the generated project check, not only inspecting generated files or opening the page.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard game CLI scenarios now run bun run check after every supported generator, matching the existing app and library creation scenarios.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable 9bc153e1 runs both normal generated game checks after GameDocumentRepository.save; both fail Prettier with [warn] game.json. The unchanged tests retain their full type, lint, unit, build and audit steps.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Generated games use the json-stringify formatter for game.json, matching the canonical tab-indented encoding used by the authoring repository; initial documents use that encoding too.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
